name: icon
title: Icon
description: Draws any Lucide icon by name, sized and colored with theme tokens.

when: A symbol helps people scan or recognize an action, status or object.
An icon-only control needs a picture; give it a label.

instead.when: The status needs a word, not only a symbol.

guidance.rule: Pair icons with text unless the meaning is universal; give a standalone icon a label.
Use the semantic colors (danger, success…) only when the icon carries that meaning.

builtIn: Decorative (hidden from assistive technology) when it has no label.
Exposed as an image named by `label` when it has one.
Directional icons mirror on right-to-left pages.
youProvide: A `label` when the icon carries meaning on its own.

genui.description: A Lucide icon by kebab-case name. Use beside text; give `label` only when the icon stands alone and carries meaning.
